title: Two Kings, One Choice
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and listens before she decides, and tonight a new king chooses the wrong voices: Scout hears her friends call her over the fence, remembers Mom’s wise words, and stays safe.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout looks and listens carefully before she decides, and Rehoboam’s whole kingdom turned on whose voice he chose to hear. In Scout’s world today: at the park her friends shout, “Let’s climb over the fence!” But Mom said to stay where she can see. Scout stops, listens for the kind and wise voice, and stays inside the fence. Just like Rehoboam should have done with the wise old men, Scout learned that listening to people who love us keeps us safe and happy.
